did.unittitle: David Rockefeller papers, Speeches

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. Brittle or damaged materials are available at the discretion of RAC.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Original order, as received. Records are further arranged in Series, primarily chronologically.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This collection consists of David Rockefeller's speeches and interviews. The material includes but is not limited to remarks and introductions at meetings, conferences, workshops, museums, press conferences, dinners, luncheons, annivesaries, and various events such as groundbreaking, tree-lighting, or ribbon-cutting ceremonies, retirement parties, weddings and memorial services.

Speeches were frequently given at events or gatherings for the following organizations, associations, and philanthropies: Americas Society, Chase Manhattan Bank, Council of the Americas, Council on Foreign Relations, Harvard University, International House, Museum of Modern Art, New York City Partnership, Rockefeller Brothers Fund, Rockefeller University, and the Trilateral Commission.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - Processing Level 1 - File-Level Access.
Records remain in original housing. Additional processing will be conducted in the future to improve description, enhance access, and long-term preservation.
